product_name: cooked grey jumbo shrimp msc s-at undecorticated
summary: The product being recalled is cooked grey jumbo shrimp msc s-at undecorticated. It is being recalled due to the presence of listeria monocytogenes, which can cause listeriosis, a serious illness. Consumers should not consume this product and contact customer service.
consumer_action: Consumers should not consume this product and contact customer service.
